# Temple: three steps up from the court's north border, two tapering pylons with cornices, a lintel
# over a dark gate, a hall behind. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.1569 0.1020 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.4196 0.1373 0.2549 --no-slot
material new Door --base-color 0.0510 0.0627 0.1059 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name S0 --size 1 --location 0.000 3.500 0.100
scale 5.400 1.100 0.200
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name S1 --size 1 --location 0.000 3.665 0.300
scale 4.900 0.770 0.200
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name S2 --size 1 --location 0.000 3.830 0.500
scale 4.400 0.440 0.200
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name PL --size 1 --location -2.0 4.550000000000001 1.4
scale 2.1 1.0 2.8
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 1"
scale 0.84 0.8 1
mode object
add mesh cube --name TL --size 1 --location -2.000 4.550 2.900
scale 1.950 0.950 0.200
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name PR --size 1 --location 2.0 4.550000000000001 1.4
scale 2.1 1.0 2.8
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 1"
scale 0.84 0.8 1
mode object
add mesh cube --name TR --size 1 --location 2.000 4.550 2.900
scale 1.950 0.950 0.200
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Lintel --size 1 --location 0.000 4.550 2.300
scale 2.300 0.850 0.420
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Door --size 1 --location 0.000 4.700 1.050
scale 1.900 0.200 2.100
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Hall --size 1 --location 0.000 5.650 0.900
scale 5.600 1.500 1.800
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Roof --size 1 --location 0.000 5.650 1.890
scale 5.800 1.700 0.180
apply --scale
select S0 S1 S2 PL PR TL TR Lintel Hall Roof
active S0
join
rename S0 Temple
material assign Stone
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Cap
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Door
material assign Door
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Temple Door
shade flat
export temple.glb
